title: Development of an electrochemical sensor based on Ni-Bio-MOF and a molecular imprinted polymer for determination of diclofenac: electrochemical and DFT investigations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16983-16998
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00194C, Paper

This study developed an electrochemical sensor based on a carbon paste electrode modified with a Ni-Bio-MOF/MIP-PL-Met nanocomposite for selective and sensitive detection of diclofenac: electrochemical and DFT investigations.
